bullets.text: A power outage occurred directly at the Thiruvallur Collectorate office, and the office should monitor electricity stability in district administrative buildings.
A rashly driven MTC bus killed a woman near Puzhal, and officials must review transport safety and bus driver compliance.
The GCC Council approved biomining and maintenance works while holding a Pallikaranai land gift deed, and the office should track these municipal project updates.
Plastic waste and garbage accumulated in the Velachery Taramani Pillaiyar Koil temple tank causing a foul smell, and local authorities must clear the waste immediately.
BJP took action regarding roads on temple land in Velachery Dhandeeswaram Temple, and the office should watch HRCE developments there.
Two female wardens were booked for harassing a plus-one student in Chennai and Nagercoil, and the office must follow up on the student protection case.
Two accused in a Thiruttani vendor murder case were detained under the Goondas Act in Puzhal jail, and police should maintain strict law and order monitoring.
A power cut interrupted DMDK leader Premalatha Vijayakanth's press meet in Tiruvallur, and local authorities should ensure uninterrupted power supply for public events.
Over 3,000 streetlights remain non-functional in Avadi despite a maintenance contract, and the municipal team must expedite repairs.
The Tamil Nadu government allocated Rs 125 crore for AI assistive devices for persons with disabilities, and the portfolio team should monitor scheme rollout.
CapitaLand launched a data centre in Ambattur providing significant IT load capacity, and the ministry should track such digital infrastructure investments.
Tamil Nadu decided to provide digital Aadhaar tags for one crore urban trees to prevent illegal felling, and the department should oversee this digital initiative.
